text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I've got a scrimmage... today? And at
Oi Racecourse too...
There's even a crowd!

text_block_list.name: People from Downtown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Inari!
Your trainer invited us, so here
we are!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Can't have a race without some noise. As
for the race, think of it as an
ice-breaker.
All these runners are gonna be your
teammates after all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A little notice woulda been nice!
But well,
if that's whatcha want me
to do, I guess
I've got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Good, that's the spirit. Now... go get
changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the race Inari One's trainer
wanted me to come see is a
scrimmage
between her and her new teammates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Scanning my surroundings, it looks like he
called together a number
of locals as well.
Everyone from the soba shop owner to that
feisty alley cat is here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And every one of them smiles warmly as
Inari One leaves the gate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(A scrimmage with all the other newbies,
huh? I get where he's comin' from, but he
couldn't have told me sooner? This isn't
somethin' you should just spring on
someone last minute. Urgh...)

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, get your head outta the clouds!
Pretty soon here she's gonna
lose steam,
and then I'll—)

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text: Urrrauuugh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Huh?! She's... speeding up!)

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text:
I, uh... I ended up in fifth,
so I guess my
stamina still needs some
work...

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Wheeze! GRRRAAAUUUGH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Hey, hey! She's... she's like a totally
different runner!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Oh no, you doooon't!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh! I'm not done... I'm not done
yeeeet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A shock to us all, Inari One seems to be
losing the battle of fighting spirit! With
only two hundred meters to go, at this
rate, she's going to
lose!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As that fear flashes through my mind, my
mouth opens on its own...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: GRRRAUUUGH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her opponent is on her tail the whole
way... but in the end, Inari One
wins by a
nose.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text: AAAUGH! Darn it aaall! I lost agaaain!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... N-now wait a minute... When did you... get so strong?

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
That was a close one... But, well,
I think ya
get the idea, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
We don't need ya stickin' around outta
obligation. Even without you,
my team'll
get the crowd goin' just fine...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Chief, what're ya talkin' about?! I'm s'posed to run on your team here in Oi Raceco—

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: For cryin' out loud, girl, didja think I wouldn't notice?! I can see that you don't wanna be here in your heart of hearts. I'm old, not blind.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
You want to go to Tracen, right? Hidin'
your true desires doesn't suit
you, girl.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: If you're a true Edo girl, you'll take on the Twinkle Series, show 'em what the downtown's made of, and become a racing sensation there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ch-Chief...

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
He's right, you know! No matter where
you're runnin', we'll be cheerin'
you on!

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Show 'em how we do things downtown!
Turn that Twinkle stage
upside down!

text_block_list.name: People from Downtown
text_block_list.text:
YEEEAH!
INARI! INARI! INARI! INARI!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Guys...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk,
wipe that gloomy look off your face.
Go, you've got transfer
paperwork to fill
out!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
You've already got a trainer ready to
scout
you... And I think we both
know they had
something to do with your victory today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Chief... Yeah. Yeah... you're right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several weeks later...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, guess who's ready to
rumble!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The downtown girl ready to throw down!
Starting today, Edo girl Inari
is takin' on all
of Tracen Academy! ...Wazzup?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just Inari's fine. Full names are for
strangers, and no way I'd take on
the road
ahead with someone I don't trust! Got
that, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just Inari's fine.
Full names're for strangers,
and no way I'd take on the road ahead
with someone I don't trust! Got that,
Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet! This sparky Oi racer's gonna set
fire to the Twinkle Series!
